name: E2E - Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    name: Run Playwright tests
    timeout-minutes: 5
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9.x

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20.x
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - run: pnpm install
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Setup Playwright
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test:e2e

}
